title: How to test handlers in pkg/api/
answers: How do I write a test for a new API handler?
What is the standard test harness in pkg/api?
How do I simulate a signed-in user with specific permissions in a pkg/api test?
body:
Standard harness: SetupAPITestServer(t, opts ...APITestServerOption) (pkg/api/common_test.go:295) builds a near-real HTTPServer with mocked service fields, calls registerRoutes(), wraps it in webtest.Server.

pkg/web/webtest/webtest.go:32 NewServer backs it with a real httptest.Server; webtest.RequestWithSignedInUser(req, user) attaches a *user.SignedInUser with explicit permissions, exercising the real RBAC middleware chain end-to-end instead of mocking it away.

Example pattern: pkg/api/folder_test.go:36 TestFoldersCreateAPIEndpoint, table-driven, sets permissions []accesscontrol.Permission per case, builds request, asserts status plus decoded DTO.
